title: Meeting notes — Build Order
rule: Record both sides of a meeting on the Mac and get a note that says only what was said; the vault gets the source, never the summary.

stages.name: Record both sides
stages.does: Microphone plus system audio through a CoreAudio tap, transcribed while recording, holding no audio in memory.
stages.see: Start meeting recording in the menu; a live transcript.

stages.name: The note
stages.does: On-device summary folded to fit the model's 4,096-token budget, talk or conversation styles, 2× playback slowed back down, pause, re-summarise, filing the source to the vault.
stages.see: A structured note when the meeting ends; the transcript filed to raw/meetings.
stages.proof: End-to-end recording checked (decisions 02, 03, 05–08). Reading while recording and fitToBudget are unit tests only.

stages.name: A real hour-long meeting
stages.does: Proves the long-meeting path on the current build.
stages.see: A note for a 60-minute meeting within budget.
stages.proof: The log shows windows read during recording, the fold report, and the note within budget.

stages.name: Who said what
stages.does: Transcribes the microphone and system audio separately and labels turns You and Them.
stages.see: The transcript and note say You: … / Them: …
stages.proof: Headphones call of 5 minutes: turns alternate You/Them in the real order, the MEETING stopped line says labelled: true. 463 tests pass; **not yet run on a live call.**

items.t: Summariser prompts and budget (≈3,440 of 4,096 worst case)

stages.name: Meeting reaches the wiki
stages.does: A filed meeting is queued for the vault's ingest, so it reaches wiki/ without a manual step.
stages.see: A meeting page in the wiki after the meeting.
stages.proof: One meeting reaches wiki/ with no manual step.
